results.description:
Trusted by millions of students, professionals, and language learners worldwide, Oxford Dictionary is powered by Oxford Languages, giving you access to over 1 million words, definitions, and translations across 15 languages in a single app. Whether you are preparing for exams, improving your writing, or expanding your vocabulary, Oxford Dictionary is your trusted language reference. 


■ What can I use Oxford Dictionary for?
- Find accurate word definitions
- Check pronunciation
- Discover English synonyms and antonyms
- Learn word origins and etymology
- Translate across 15 languages
- Build vocabulary and improve writing
- Access trusted language references online and offline

■ How many dictionaries are included?
15 Oxford dictionaries: monolingual editions for British and American English, plus bilingual dictionaries in French, German, Spanish, Russian, Chinese, Italian, Hindi, Urdu, Portuguese, Japanese, Greek, Bulgarian, and Thai.

■ How do I find the meaning of a word?
Search for any word to access trusted Oxford definitions, example usage, phrase support, word origins, and language references powered by Oxford Languages.

■ Does Oxford Dictionary work offline?
Yes. Oxford Dictionary includes full offline access. Download dictionaries to your device and search for words anytime, no internet connection needed. Ideal for travel, studying, or working anywhere.

■ Does Oxford Dictionary include a thesaurus?
Yes. An integrated thesaurus gives you thousands of synonyms and antonyms in English, helping you find the right word, avoid repetition, and improve your writing. Available with Premium.

■ Does Oxford Dictionary have pronunciation support?
Yes. High-quality audio pronunciations in English help you speak with confidence, essential for language learning and exam preparation.

■ Can I search for words even if I don't know the spelling?
Yes. Use voice search, fuzzy search, autocomplete suggestions, keyword lookup, and camera search to find words quickly and easily.

■ Is Oxford Dictionary good for IELTS, TOEFL, SAT, or ACT preparation?
Yes. Oxford Dictionary provides accurate definitions, example usage in context, and a broad vocabulary range trusted by students and academics preparing for major English proficiency exams worldwide.

■ How can I build my vocabulary with Oxford Dictionary?
Save words to Favorites, organise them into folders, revisit Recent searches, and discover a new word every day with Word of the Day.

■ Should I use an AI chatbot instead of a dictionary?
Research shows that students and professionals continue to rely on dedicated dictionaries for formal definitions and verified word usage. Oxford Dictionary provides definitions backed by Oxford Languages' rigorous editorial process, not AI-generated approximations. When accuracy matters, it remains the trusted reference.

■ Who is Oxford Dictionary for?
Students, writers, professionals, academics, language learners, and word enthusiasts — anyone who needs a reliable multilingual dictionary at every level.

■ What do you get with Premium?
- Unlimited database access 
- Offline and fast mode 
- Audio pronunciations 
- Full thesaurus 
- Regular Oxford Languages updates 
- Ad-free experience

■ Why choose Oxford Dictionary?
Oxford Dictionary combines trusted Oxford language expertise with powerful search technology, multilingual support, offline access, and intuitive vocabulary tools, all in one app. Download Oxford Dictionary and experience the world's most trusted language reference.
